teaching.description: Mu kiganiro giheruka twihweje ivyanditswe mu mirongo itatu yambere y'icete canditswe na Yuda. Ubwa mbere twarumvise yuko kino cete candikiwe abizeye yesu Kristo aribo Yuda yise abahamagawe bakundwa, abo nibo rero bakundwa n'Imana . Ubwa kabiri, twarumvise yuko abana b'Imana aribo bafise amahoro nyakuri kuko amahoro atangwa n'Imana nabo bakaba ari abakundwa bayo. Ubwa gatatu twarumvise ko abana b'Imana bategerezwa kwirinda inyigisho z'ibinyoma bakitwararika kumenya n'ukwamamaza ukwizera kwatanguye kwigishijwe n'intumwa za Yesu Kristo.

teaching.description: Twarabiye hamwe ingene Yuda mu cete yanditse, yagabishije abizera Imana abereka yuko abari mw'ishengero bose atari bene data. Twarumvise muri ca cete ca Yuda 1 : 4 yuko mw'ishengero habamwo abansi b'Imana binyegejemwo. Abigisha b'ibinyoma nuyu musi usanga banyegetereye mw'ishengero bagahakana ivy'Imana bakahaba batizera inyigisho z'ijambo ry'Imana ariko kubera ukwiyorobeka kwabo n'uburyarya bwabo usanga bashika naho bahabwa ibikorwa mw'ishengero. Niho rero usanga hari abakozi b'Imana bamamaza ijambo ryayo kumunwa gusa ariko bataryemera.
teaching.name: Yuda agabisha abizera Imana

content: Ndagomba kubibutsa, naho vyose musanzwe mubizi, yuko Umwami Imana, imaze gukiza bwa bwoko ikabukura mu gihugu ca Misiri, hanyuma yahoneje abatizeye.

teaching.description: Mu kiganiro giheruka, twigishijwe ivy'ukwirinda abigisha b'ibinyoma no kwitwararika kugumana ukwizera kuzima. Ukwo kwizera kuzima n'ugushimikiye ku gupfa no kuzuka kwa Yesu Kristo, uwapfuye avuye mw'ijuru aje gucungura abo mw'isi. Twarumvise ko mw'ishengero hama hariho abigisha b'ibinyoma baba bake baba benshi bikaba bikenewe yuko umukristo wese yo kwiyubara ntafatanye nabo. Twaribukijwe ko hari akaga gakomeye ku bantu bata ukwizera.

teaching.description: Twaganiriye ku migwi itatu yabagize ivyago aho hambere kubera ivyaha vyabo vy'ubugarariji vyababaje Imana. Iyo migwi itatu niyo yiyi: 1)Ab'isirayeli bataye ukwizera banka kwinjira mu gihugu c'isezerano kandi hari hageze. 2) N'abamalayika bagararije Imana bagakurikira satani bamwe baciye bakororerwa mu vyobo vy'umwiza aho barindiwe baboshwe n'iminyororo biteze gucirirwa kw'iteka abandi bakorera mw'isi nibo badayimoni bayerera mw'isi bakora ibibi.3) N'abantu b'Isodomu n' I Gomora n'ibisagara bihereranye naho ingene ubusambanyi bwabo bwatumye ibisagara vyabo biturigwa.
